name: Planet Atlas
notes: Local-space worlds use kind-driven albedo instead of one globe with a tint swap: continents and ice caps, dune/canyon desert, cratered barren and metal, lava cracks, toxic cloud decks, and banded giants with storms.
Atlas kinds: earth-like, ocean, arid, ice, metal-rich, mineral, volcanic, barren, toxic, gas giant, and ice giant. Classification still follows orbit and star class — no Earth-like gas giants.
Atmosphere limbs, star-facing terminators, and two-band rings. Surface and on-foot sites pick up type cues. Flight, docking, and landing rules are unchanged.
DEV → Planet atlas hops to a body of each kind for review.
